# JobQueueOptions.drainTimeout property

Milliseconds a drain waits for jobs in flight before giving up on them. Ignored unless [JobQueueOptions.drain](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueoptions.drain/) is on.

**Signature:**

```typescript
drainTimeout?: number;
```

## Default Value

the `IMQ_DRAIN_TIMEOUT` environment variable, itself [DEFAULT\_IMQ\_DRAIN\_TIMEOUT](/api/job/latest/job.default_imq_drain_timeout/) (4000)

## Remarks

The wait is always bounded and the process always exits. This is the number to raise for jobs that legitimately take longer than a few seconds — the 4000 default is sized for the `imq stop` CLI, not for your handlers. Whatever is still running when it expires is abandoned, and [JobQueueOptions.drainRequeue](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueoptions.drainrequeue/) decides whether it comes back.
